2026-11-18-item-9-looks.webp | The bark's color, normal and depth and an atlas of each of the six leaf shapes at a width of 0.6, as TreeLooks makes them, the leaves tinted by a species' default leaf color on a white ground.
2026-11-18-item-9-leaf-outlines.webp | The two maples at widths 1 and 0.6 and the three leaflets and the oval at 0.1, each before the mend on the left and after it on the right, the maples' lobes pointed and veined over a small base that meets the stalk and every leaf one piece from its stalk to its tips.
2026-11-18-item-9-aspen-exact.webp | The quaking aspen at seed 1 grown with the runtime's functions beside the same seed grown with the module's own arithmetic, which every system grows alike, and in red the one of its 22,499 cards that moved more than a millimeter, by 9.8 cm; its stems moved by a micrometer at most.
2026-11-18-item-9-presets-sets.webp | The six presets at seed 1 drawn with their own bark and leaf sets from the carried KTX2 files, the leaves sampled by their own texture coordinates and cut by alpha, each beside the same tree in its sets' mean colors, as bright as the sets they stand for; the bark is mapped round its stems by a stand-in, since the module holds no stem mesh, and the fern, which names no bark set, takes its bark color.
2026-11-18-item-10-leaf-spread.webp | The six presets at seed 1 before and after the leaves are shared by a twig's length, drawn with their sets, the weeping willow large beside them; a long twig is leafed along its length, and the willow's long hanging stems, which carry their few twigs near their ends, stand as bare as before.
2026-11-18-item-10-willow-curtain.webp | The weeping willow at seeds 1 to 4 large, as it grew before beside its buds reading their light outward from the trunk, drawn with its sets, its curtain hanging from the crown to near the ground where it stood round.
2026-11-19-item-9-stems-bark.webp | The quaking aspen's stems at seed 1 drawn with the silver birch's bark by their own count round and coordinate along, the whole tree beside its lowest three meters, lit as round, the bark's marks keeping their shape up the tapering trunk.
2026-11-22-readme-trees.webp | The quaking aspen, the black tupelo, the weeping willow and the California black oak at seed 1, each grown from its preset and drawn with its own bark and leaf textures from the carried KTX2 files.
2026-11-22-readme-grass.webp | A patch of wheat grass two meters by one at 14 clumps a meter, each clump two crossed cards of the grass texture scattered by a seed, seen from a little above.
